name: dynart/dpress-disqus
description: Comments through Disqus for dpress, loaded when a reader asks for them and not before.
_comment: Installing this plugin is dropping the folder into `plugins/` - dpress does not read this
file at all. A plugin is a folder with a `plugin.ini` in it, and the loader autoloads
`src/` from the namespace the manifest names.
This is here for the tests, which need PHPUnit and need dpress's own classes to type
against. It resolves dpress out of the checkout three folders up, which is where it is on
the machine this is written on. Elsewhere, run the tests against a dpress checkout by
pointing that path at it - there is nothing to install for the plugin to *work*.
